name: murkfun-mcp
description: MurkFun MCP server (stdio) for your own AI agent: private meme-token trading on BSC funded by 0xbow Privacy Pools and Railgun. Every order is signed by your wallet for that exact order and proven locally (Noir); keeps the seed signature and 0xbow secrets in an encrypted local vault and sends only proved orders to a MurkFun relayer.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test --test-reporter=spec test/unit.test.ts test/safety.test.ts test/trade.test.ts test/orders.test.ts test/upload.test.ts test/holderpath.test.ts test/holderslookup.test.ts test/recipients.test.ts
